$comment: Project-shared Claude Code settings for KlaudeCrew; companion to CLAUDE.md section 8. TRACKED FILE = RESTRICTIONS ONLY. claude-agent-acp (this product's own backend) reads <cwd>/.claude/settings.json whenever a Kiro Crew session is bound to this checkout, and a project-scope permissions.allow rule would let that backend approve tools locally without ever reaching Kiro Crew's approval UI / PreToolUse gate. So this file carries only deny rules and the PreToolUse guard hook (both narrow, never widen). The developer-agent convenience allowlist lives in .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored, machine-local; see CLAUDE.md section 8 for the seed-clobber caveat).
